claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to schedule new auction events by creating an auction group from selected auction products and configuring the group either by applying an event profile or by setting each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to schedule new auction events by creating an auction group from selected auction products and configuring the group either by applying an event profile or by setting each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer has searched for and selected a list of auction product.
The Auctioneer initiates scheduling new auctions after searching for and selecting a list of auction products.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer initiates scheduling new auctions after searching for and selecting a list of auction products.

claims.content: After searching for and selecting a list of auction product, the Auctioneer edits the selected auction items.
Editable fields are shown in gray.
The Auctioneer navigates from field to field using the TAB key and the arrow keys, or using the mouse.
The Auctioneer copies and pastes data between fields.

Once the auction group is created, the Auctioneer either applies an "event profile" to the group or creates the auction manually by setting each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time.
If the Auctioneer creates the auction manually, once the duration and ending time are filled in, the opening time is system-generated (calculated).
4a. If the Auctioneer chooses to apply an "event profile" to the auction group, apply the event profile to the group instead of creating the auction manually; this is faster.

1. If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with the same starting & ending date / time, the system results in an error message and highlights (color-codes) the offending data; the scheduling application does not allow the Auctioneer to create the auction with the same starting & ending date / time, so the auction is not created and the flow exits.
The auction group is created.
A schedule and parameters are created for the selected SKUs.
The auction group is configured either by applying an "event profile" to the group or by creating the auction manually with each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time set.
If the auction was created manually, the opening time is system-generated (calculated) after the duration and ending time are filled in.
The auction does not have the same starting & ending date / time.
